title: metadata-protocol: a disabled doc holder registered last turns the bare doc read, /layers and /published into 404 although an enabled package ships the name
body:
domain:server#5 · zhuangjianguo · session_01QsR2jUcj2x2Wr4UErwBi12

Filing gate: ① a product defect with a named location, measured. Found by area S5's dev on #33264 (report 6898101382, out_of_scope_findings, class a), filed by area S5 (E1b), lease E1.

## 维护者速读

- 问题：两个包发布同名文档，其中被停用的包最后注册时，按名字裸读、`/layers`、`/published` 都返回 404，尽管启用中的包发布了这个名字。
- 影响：启用包的文档读不到，违反 ADR-0150 D3（停用的包不持有名字）。
- 修法方向：把 `servedHolderAddressOf` 的"被服务持有者"判断扩展到文档这类不按包读取的类型。
- 优先级 p2，本区（S5）处理。

## Measured

On the same composed artifact server, with one of two holders disabled and registered last: bare `GET /meta/doc/NAME`, `/layers` and `/published` answer 404. That is the answer on origin/main 1e65a389 and on PR #34036's head.

Seam (read): `packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol-meta-item-face.ts` `servedHolderAddressOf` covers readsByPackage types only.

## Acceptance

1. The bare doc read and its `/layers` / `/published` faces serve the enabled holder when the only other holder is disabled, in both orders. Pin and ablate. CONTROL: both disabled stays 404, and two enabled stays 409 (PR #34036).
2. Check the other non-readsByPackage types for the same shape, and fix them in one PR.
3. Declare the FROM→TO with its Clause-② arm.

Prior rulings read: ADR-0150 D3 (a disabled package holds no name) and D4; ruling 6893582352 on #33264 ("a disabled holder: no refusal"); fold PR #33995 (#33385/#33401) edits `protocol-meta-item-face.ts` for `_env`. That is the same file, so merge-tree it before the claim. No test was found that pins the 404.

## Dedupe

I searched "disabled holder doc 404" and "served holder doc", and found only #33264. #32605 (PR #33889) is the bare save, not the doc read.
